how_to_apply: Applications are accepted only online. The bank will not accept any other mode. You need a valid personal email ID and mobile number, and both must stay active until the recruitment is over, because call letters may be sent by email. If you do not have a personal email ID, create one before you apply. You can read the detailed advertisement by clicking "Download Advertisement" under "Recruitment Advertisement – Manager" on the portal.
Go to https://apps.tmbdigital.bank.in/tmb_careers/, click "Apply Online" and register for the post of Manager.
The bank sends an activation link to your registered email ID, and your Registration Number and Password to your registered mobile number. Note them down. Without them you cannot continue.
Click the activation link. It takes you to the Careers portal.

Log in with your Application number (Registration Number / Username) and password, using the login on the right side of the portal. Fill in every page and click "Save/ Continue" on each one. Spell your name, and your father's or husband's name, exactly as they appear in your certificates and mark sheets. Any change or alteration may disqualify you.
Upload your photograph: preferably 390 X 520 pixels, and no more than 120 KB.
Upload your signature: preferably 240 X 240 pixels, and no more than 60 KB. A signature in capital letters will not be accepted.
Upload the enclosures listed below. Each scanned image must be no more than 250 KB.
Click confirm/submit at the bottom of the page. The message "Registration is successful" will appear.
A system-generated copy of your application is sent to your registered email ID. Print it and keep it for reference.
Self-attested photocopy of your SSLC or Higher Secondary Mark Sheet / Transfer Certificate, as proof of age
Self-attested photocopy of your degree certificate(s)
Experience certificate(s) and relieving letter(s) from previous employers
Applications with wrong or incomplete details, or without the required certificate copies, are liable to be rejected. If any information turns out to be wrong at any stage, you will be disqualified.

content_sections.heading: TMB Manager (Generalist) Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Not more than 35 years as on 30/09/2026. Any Graduate / Post Graduate from a recognized university under regular curriculum. You need 5 years of experience in banking. At least 3 of those years must be service as an Assistant Manager, Deputy Manager or in an equivalent cadre in a bank. The candidate chosen for appointment must not have any vigilance case or adverse observation from the RBI or a Statutory Authority pending against them. The full eligibility conditions for the post are in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee is Nil, so you pay nothing to apply.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The bank checks every e-application and draws up a shortlist. Shortlisted applicants are told the interview details individually, by post or e-mail. The personal interview is held either in person (Direct) or by Video Conferencing. The bank tells eligible candidates the mode, date and time individually. The bank's decision on eligibility, the interview and selection is final. It can remove ineligible candidates at any time before, during or after the interview.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: You can be posted anywhere in India. The job role and location can be transferred, depending on the bank's requirements. The post is filled on a regular basis. Canvassing in any form will disqualify you.

faq.question: Q1. How much banking experience do I need for TMB Manager (Generalist)?
faq.answer: You need 5 years of banking experience in total. At least 3 of those years must be as an Assistant Manager, Deputy Manager or in an equivalent cadre in a bank.

faq.question: Q2. Which degree is accepted?
faq.answer: The notice accepts any Graduate or Post Graduate from a recognised university, as long as it was a regular-curriculum course.

faq.question: Q3. What is the upper age limit, and on what date is it counted?
faq.answer: You must be no older than 35 years on 30 September 2026.

faq.question: Q4. Do I need to pay a fee to apply?
faq.answer: No. The application fee is Nil.

faq.question: Q5. How will the interview be held?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates have a personal interview, either in person or by video conferencing. The bank will send the mode, date and time to each of them individually.

faq.question: Q6. What photo and signature sizes does the portal accept?
faq.answer: The photograph should preferably be 390 X 520 pixels and no more than 120 KB. The signature should preferably be 240 X 240 pixels and no more than 60 KB. A signature in capital letters is not accepted.

faq.question: Q7. Which documents must I upload with the application?
faq.answer: You must upload your SSLC or Higher Secondary mark sheet or Transfer Certificate as age proof, your degree certificates, your experience certificates and relieving letters, and your last month's salary slip. Each file must be 250 KB or smaller.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the selected candidate be posted?
faq.answer: The posting can be anywhere in India. The job role and location can be transferred depending on the bank's requirements.

faq.question: Q9. Can a pending vigilance case affect my selection?
faq.answer: Yes. The candidate chosen for appointment must not have any vigilance case or adverse observation from the RBI or a Statutory Authority pending against them.
